title: D03: Add independent native BNGIR contracts and adversarial fixtures

source.contract: Author source-independent valid and invalid JSON cases for every structural field and cross-reference; execute valid reconstructions natively and assert malformed inputs fail before partial model mutation; detect dropped units, reversed rules, wrong bonds, population maps and observable relations.

oracle.identity: Independent analytic continuous-time laws, hand-authored adversarial BNGIR v0.2 fixture suite, and native importer refusal controls.
oracle.law: Native BNGIR importer must accept valid hand-authored v0.2 documents matching exact continuous-time trajectories (A(t)=A0*exp(-kt), A(t)=A0*exp(-2*base*t)); malformed inputs fail closed with NativeRefusal before partial model state mutation; semantic mutations produce observable trajectory deviations or are decidably inequivalent.
